ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, a hexagon $ABCDEF$ has equal interior angles, and $AD\parallel BC$. What is the measure of $\angle DAB$ in degrees?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution}: Since the internal angles of the hexagon ABCDEF are all equal,\\
each internal angle is: $(6-2) \times 180^\circ \div 6 = 120^\circ$,\\
that is, $\angle ABC = 120^\circ$,\\
since BC$\parallel$AD,\\
thus $\angle DAB = 180^\circ - \angle ABC = \boxed{60^\circ}$.
